name: Shiba Chihane
source:
"Indeed, virtuous as I am, I've merely been appointed as God by the Kamibana."

The heiress of the Shiba family, who have presided over the village shrine for several generations. An absent-minded girl, often lost within her own daydreams, believing herself to be a God. She prays for the happiness of all those around her, kind as a saint. During the previous Hanamukenogi ceremony, she was chosen as a candidate for the Kamibana, despite having only been nine years of age.

Flower: Marvel-of-Peru
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [???]

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Chihane_Shiba]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
